details:
This post is kinda connected to this post : https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/loading-between-worlds
Everytime portal works like, someone drop that portal in world, you run trough and you see downloading and loading screen.
But there should be place for another type of portal, could be good if we had option to drop 'group portal' which teleport users in queue only after everyone in queue download that world. Or open portal only after users in queue download world.
How i imagine it should work:
- Users can connect to that portal only for limited time which can be set. ( 5 - 30 seconds)
- After that limited time , portal should dissapear for users which not joined in time.
- During droping there should be possible to choose if you want normal portal or group portal or some different portal. This idea is based on that.. another idea will be already in the game. 
  >> https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/improved-portal-drop-system
- Specials types of portals only available in Private and Friends/+ instances as these custom types could be anoying in public worlds:
  - Letter 'portal' where you can customize message and then people can pass that from one user to another and they could see who is already joined to that letter invite and after some time, letter dissapears with cool animation and everyone who joined through that letter, will start downloading that world.
  - Rectangual portal which kinda split room in half, show loaded world and un-render current world after you walk trough. 
  - Tracked portal.. more like tracked bird, you set which users should go with you and then bird will fly in the world and drop letter for everyone who is on the list, on that letter should be name of person which created that and then these users , can refuse to join or agree to join , of course in limited time. You can ignore that letter, you can throw away that letter or open that letter and click on ''I wanna go!/Count with me!'' or ''I'm not interested/Go without me''and if you throw that letter away from you with certain velocity, then that letter will be automaticaly destroyed for you.
title: Different portals for different purposes
